scripts.local: concurrently -k -n api,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run local -w @eleanor/api" "npm run local -w @eleanor/client"
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @eleanor/api && npm run typecheck -w @eleanor/client
scripts.build: npm run build -w @eleanor/api && npm run build -w @eleanor/client
scripts.test: npm run test -w @eleanor/api && npm run test -w @eleanor/client
